statBlock.name: Aarakocra Aeromancer
statBlock.description: This birdfolk spellcaster draws on the endless storms of the Elemental Plane of Air to command wind and lightning.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wind Staff attacks. The aarakocra can also use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.
Wind Staff. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 13. These spells need no material components.
At will. Elementalism, Gust of Wind, Mage Hand, Message.
1/day. Lightning Bolt.
sections.Reactions: Feather Fall (1/day). Cast Feather Fall when its trigger occurs, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Air.

statBlock.name: Aarakocra Skirmisher
statBlock.description: The skirmisher fights in the clouds and dives at enemies on the ground.

sections.Actions:
Talons. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the aarakocra moved at least 30 ft. straight toward the target immediately before hitting, the damage is 9 (3d4 + 2) instead.
Wind Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) thunder damage. After any ranged attack with it, the javelin immediately returns to the aarakocra's hand by magic.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Air.

statBlock.name: Bullywug Bog Sage
statBlock.description: This fey marsh keeper calls on swamp magic to sicken enemies and speak with plants.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The bullywug breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. The bullywug can express simple ideas to frogs and toads by speaking Bullywug.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bog Staff attacks. Replace either or both attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness.
Bog Staff. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks.
At will. Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, Ray of Sickness.
1/day each. Speak with Plants, Vitriolic Sphere.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. The bullywug spends 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

statBlock.name: Bullywug Warrior
statBlock.description: These fey amphibians ambush intruders in swamps, often alongside trained Giant Frogs.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The bullywug breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. The bullywug can express simple ideas to frogs and toads by speaking Bullywug.
sections.Actions: Insectile Rapier. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. The bullywug spends 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

statBlock.name: Centaur Warden
statBlock.description: A fey guardian of forests, grasslands, and places of primal power.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Forest Staff or Sun Ray for each.
Forest Staff. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Sun Ray. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 90 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) radiant damage and leaves the target Blinded until the start of the centaur's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting: As an action, cast Druidcraft or Speak with Animals at will. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 15.
sections.Bonus actions: Entangling Trail (recharge 5–6). Move up to the centaur's speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 ft. of the centaur at any point during this move makes one DC 15 Strength save. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Azer Pyromancer
statBlock.description: A living bronze smith who conjures elemental fire to heat magical forges and fend off attackers.

sections.Traits:
Fire Aura. At the end of each of the azer's turns, the azer chooses which creatures in its 5-ft. Emanation take 11 (2d10) fire damage. The aura deals no damage while the azer is Incapacitated.
Illumination. The azer sheds Bright Light for 10 ft. and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flame Burst attacks.
Flame Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 15. These spells need no material components.
At will. Elementalism, Mage Hand.
1/day. Fireball.
sections.Reactions: Hellish Rebuke (2/day). Cast Hellish Rebuke when its trigger occurs, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability and save DC 15.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Fire.

statBlock.name: Githzerai Psion
statBlock.description: This psion guides a githzerai sanctuary and may lead a strike against a mind flayer colony.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psychic Warp attacks.
Psychic Warp. Melee or ranged attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 26 (4d10 + 4) psychic damage. For a Large or smaller creature, the githzerai chooses whether the hit leaves the target Charmed until the start of the githzerai's next turn or knocks it Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 16. These spells need no components.
At will. Mage Hand. The hand is Invisible.
1/day each. Plane Shift, See Invisibility.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense. Cast Feather Fall or Shield when that spell's trigger occurs. Use Intelligence as the spellcasting ability and omit all components.
